headings.usage: Used for all major headings, hero text, and manifesto chapters to provide a bespoke, high-end editorial feel.
headings.styles: tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for large sizes. Never center-align hero.

body.usage: Used for body copy, supporting text, and UI elements (buttons, small labels) for modern readability.

accent.styles: uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs or text-sm for overlines and labels.

background.description: Soft linen and bright off-white for a spacious, airy feel.

text.description: Deep charcoal for high contrast, warm greys for secondary text.

accents.description: Natural wood tones for borders, subtle highlights, and the primary rich dark pill CTA.

surfaces: No drop shadows on modern bento cards, use 1px solid borders with wood_light color.
Clipped frames for product photography (e.g., arch tops or slightly rounded corners rounded-2xl).
Floating sticky CTA uses 'Crystal Glass' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-white/40).
textures: Subtle noise overlay on the primary background to simulate linen/paper texture (opacity 2-3%).

grids_and_layouts.spacing_strategy: Generous spacing. Use p-12, p-24, p-32 for section padding. Containers should have breathing room.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For the workshop update, use a high-density asymmetric grid (e.g., md:grid-cols-12, spanning 8 and 4).
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align primarily for a confident, editorial look. Avoid generic center-alignment unless intentional for testimonials.

hero.description: Large kinetic hero with a signature on-load moment. Masked line-by-line headline reveal. Subtle parallax image moment.

sticky_cta.description: Floating pill CTA linked to WhatsApp/Phone (+2784 090 0658 - Clive). Stays visible on scroll.
sticky_cta.styles: fixed bottom-8 right-8 z-50 bg-[#2D241E] text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 flex items-center gap-2 shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform

editorial_marquee.description: Slow moving text strip separating sections.
editorial_marquee.content: Custom Cabinetry • Architectural Joinery • Handcrafted Furniture • Spatial Fitting • Wood Restoration
editorial_marquee.styles: py-8 bg-[#EAE6DF] text-[#2D241E] font-serif text-3xl uppercase tracking-widest

workshop_bento.description: Bento layout showing recent workshop updates with real product photography treated deliberately (spotlight, clipped frames).

manifesto_chapters.description: Numbered sections detailing the studio's philosophy.
manifesto_chapters.styles: Large typography numbers (01, 02) paired with bold text, massive padding.

testimonials_wall.description: Grid of quotes from clients and architects.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_and_interactions.reveals: Framer Motion for scroll-reveals (fade up, slow ease-out) and masked text reveals on load.
motion_and_interactions.hover: Image zoom inside clipped frames (overflow-hidden, scale-105 on hover).

hero_background.description: Empty room with wooden walls and beams. Used for the subtle parallax hero background or adjacent visual.

workshop_1.description: Wooden table with workshop details. Used for the workshop bento grid.

workshop_2.description: Person cutting wood. Used for the workshop bento grid.

cabinetry.description: Modern kitchen with custom cabinetry. Used in the expertise/services section.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #2D241E text on #F9F8F6 background passes APCA.
accessibility.testing: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, links).

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the entire page in standard React functional components.
Include 'react-lenis' wrapper at the root for smooth scrolling.
For the hero headline, split the text into lines and use framer-motion to reveal them from a masked container (overflow: hidden, translateY 100% to 0%).
Implement the floating sticky CTA with a high z-index and subtle shadow. The link must be 'https://wa.me/27840900658'.
Use react-fast-marquee for the editorial marquee.
Make the page feel extremely premium by applying large paddings (e.g. py-24, py-32). Do not cram content.
DO NOT use Inter or standard fonts. Import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in index.css.
Ensure the hero background image is treated nicely (perhaps parallax with framer motion's useScroll).
Use Tailwind arbitrary values for custom colors if not added to config.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
